test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The tomb of Sher Shah Suri is located in _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __Sasaram.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Sher Shah Suri was a Pathan from Bihar who founded the Suri empire after defeating the Mughal empire.
 
• In his memory, a tomb designed by Mir Muhammad Aliwal Khan was built in Sasaram, Bihar and it is an example of Indo-Islamic Architecture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Sher Shah Suri died in a gunpowder explosion in the fort of Kalinjar.
 
• The tomb of Sher Shah Suri is also known as the Second Taj Mahal of India as it is built in between an artificial lake.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__** 

 
• In Delhi, the construction of Purana Qila was begun during the time of Humayun which continued till the time of Sher Shah Suri.
 
• The son of Suri, Salim Shah Suri built the Salimgarh fort in Delhi.
 
• Grand Trunk Road connecting Central Asia and India was built by Sher Shah Suri.

Sher Shah Suri tomb in Sasaram, Bihar
